svg.text: App-only access: a tool for data users cannot reach directly
The gateway is the control, because the source cannot tell users apart · Last updated 2026-11-12
Validate the token; is the tool on this agent's allow-list?
Does the user's token carry the app role for this tool?
Rate limit; write the audit trace (agent, user, decision)
Easy Auth checks it; not used downstream
Ask for an Azure SQL token
as its managed identity; no secret
Token: the app's identity, no user
Query cost centres with that token
Authorises the app: the database user
Rows: the same for every user
Azure SQL never sees the user. The controls are the gateway's check on who may use the tool and the app's narrow database permissions.
